decisions.reason: The safety shoe line sits in the firm's core business, and in-house production and existing distribution keep it cheap to hold; after D was withdrawn it is the main new safety shoe option, so its value should be allowed to resolve further.

The supportive insole is still cheap to keep and its value is not yet clear, but with the moulded insole F as the flagship it faces overlap and remains the most likely candidate for the next round of insole pruning.
Firefighter and rescue boots depend on certification and tender cycles that resolve slowly, so dropping them after two years would give up a specialised growth option too early.
The moulded insole is the firm's flagship and a strategic commitment, and the withdrawal of B strengthens its role in the insole range.
